steps.expression: (() => { const rate = 8000; const samples = rate * 30; const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + samples * 2); const view = new DataView(buffer); const tag = (offset, value) => [...value].forEach((c, i) => view.setUint8(offset + i, c.charCodeAt(0))); tag(0, 'RIFF'); view.setUint32(4, 36 + samples * 2, true); tag(8, 'WAVEfmt '); view.setUint32(16, 16, true); view.setUint16(20, 1, true); view.setUint16(22, 1, true); view.setUint32(24, rate, true); view.setUint32(28, rate * 2, true); view.setUint16(32, 2, true); view.setUint16(34, 16, true); tag(36, 'data'); view.setUint32(40, samples * 2, true); for (let i = 0; i < samples; i += 1) view.setInt16(44 + i * 2, Math.round(Math.sin((2 * Math.PI * 440 * i) / rate) * 6000), true); const data = new DataTransfer(); data.items.add(new File([buffer], 'trilha.wav', { type: 'audio/wav' })); window.__drop = data; document.querySelector('[data-testid=sheet-column]').dispatchEvent(new DragEvent('dragenter', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, dataTransfer: data })); return data.types.includes('Files'); })()
